_comment: DEMO CONTENT. Answers are written to be spoken aloud: short, contracted, no lists, no markup. These are quoted almost verbatim on a call, so they are held to the same voice rules as the prompt.

faqs.a: Monday to Friday we're open ten to one in the morning, and five to eight in the evening. Saturday is ten to two. We're closed on Sunday.
It's six hundred rupees for a consultation. If you're coming back for a follow-up within fifteen days, that's three hundred.
We don't do cashless insurance here, but you'll get a proper receipt and prescription so you can claim it back yourself.
You can, though you might be waiting a while. If you'd like I can book you a time now and you'll be seen straight away.
You'll see Dr Meera Iyer. She's a general physician, MBBS and an MD in General Medicine, and she's been practising eighteen years.
We're on the second floor of Sunder Chambers, on Lokhandwala Road in Andheri West. There's a lift, and the entrance is just past the chemist.
Any earlier prescriptions and test reports, and a list of whatever you're already taking. That's usually all she needs.

faqs.q: How long does an appointment take?
faqs.a: Each slot is fifteen minutes. If it's a first visit or something complicated, do allow a bit longer.
Yes, we do routine blood work at the clinic. Reports normally come back the next working day and the desk will message you.
Yes, Dr Iyer sees children as well as adults. For anything under a year old, do mention it when you book.

faqs.q: Can I get a repeat prescription without coming in?
faqs.a: That's Dr Iyer's call rather than mine, so the safest thing is to book a short follow-up and she can sort it out then.

faqs.q: Can I cancel or change my appointment?
faqs.a: Of course. I can find it from the number you're calling on, or you can give me the four digit booking number.
Yes, we'll give you a ring about half an hour before, just so it doesn't slip your mind.
Not at the moment, I'm afraid. Everything's at the clinic.
There's paid parking in the building basement, and usually space on the road outside except at peak hours.
